summary: Tested SIROTECH umbrella landing page — backend POST /api/contact + frontend i18n, navigation, brand cards, services dropdown, contact form, and external CTAs. 7/7 pytest backend tests passing and 17/17 Playwright frontend checks passing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (server.py): @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers. Non-blocking.
Frontend (Contact.tsx): Submitting with HTTP error sets status='error' but no analytics/log of the response body — would help debugging on prod. Minor.
Frontend external links use rel='noreferrer' only — noreferrer implies noopener so it is safe, but adding rel='noopener noreferrer' is more conventional. Cosmetic.
i18n.tsx: t() returns 'any' (intentional for arrays/objects); consider overloaded generics for type safety. Cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed contact_messages records and clean them up after the test class via mongo fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py covers root, valid/minimal/invalid/missing-field cases and verifies MongoDB persistence in contact_messages. email_sent=false is expected (SMTP_HOST empty). Frontend Playwright covered: hero HU/EN headlines, 4 brand cards, lang toggle + localStorage persistence across reload, services dropdown hover reveals nav-link-sironic/siroved/sirosoft, anchor scroll for hero-primary-cta(#brands)/hero-secondary-cta(#contact)/navbar-quote-btn(#contact)/nav-link-sironic(#sironic), empty-form validation errors visible, full successful submission triggers contact-success. Deepdive CTAs and pricing CTA correctly point to https://sironic.hu / siroved.hu / sirosoft.hu with target=_blank.
